work.title: Guernica, Tall
work.description: Vertical digital collage bearing the text 'GuErNiCa' in mixed-case letters across a red-and-black urban texture at top; below, mirrored fragmented faces with yellow eyes are overlaid by horizontal color bands—cyan, yellow, red—while warplane silhouettes and compact discs occupy the lower registers against black-and-white photographic strips.
work.composition: axial vertical totem with text crown
